name: iteration9-five-variant-frozen-generation-assay
checkpoint_selection: All development sequence-arm final states; table/numbers 2 replicas Code and 2 replicas Lee. Same ordered evaluation seeds; no selection by outcome.

variants.readout_off: Same acquired state; configure_sequence_memory(False). Frozen generation only.
variants.initial_transitions: Restore wc,wz,bc,bz from SequenceMemory(model.seed); retain acquired v,bias,steps and all other organism state.
variants.state_zero: At each distribution call pass zero hidden prefix; retain every learned parameter. Actual generation state/history/RNG untouched.
variants.prefix_permuted: At each distribution call recompute only recurrent hidden prefix over permuted actual history. Copy history then swap adjacent entries at i,i+1 for i in range(2,len(history)-9,2). Preserve BOS, first ordinary unit, last eight, multiset and length. Actual emitted source, context lookup, candidate support and RNG untouched.

permutation_provenance: Exact operator already frozen in tools/run_lee_iteration9.py prefix_permutation; not a new reverse-middle operator.
measurement: Observe original _distribution frame return; exact weights/sum(weights), all candidates. Match actual token prefixes across variants until first token divergence; no canonical source re-encoding.
record_identity: Genuine and readout_off complete generated dicts must equal closed evaluation journals after tuple/list JSON normalization, including source/raw_hex/tokens/choices/strategy/exploring/truncated.
metrics: TV sum and maximum without thresholding
controls_interpretation: state_zero retains learned token effects but removes prior-unit state; prefix_permuted changes order with protected first and recent units. Hidden difference alone does not establish probability or utility effect. initial_transitions separates trained transitions from fixed random transitions with learned readout.
raw_trace: Private gzip JSONL includes each original generated dict, all histories/candidate probabilities/hidden states and every intervention comparison. Summary is compact.
quality: No CPython program runtime, no game episodes, no learning or model selection. Quality only in separate previously frozen experiments.
example_selection: First source/token difference in fixed checkpoint/seed order for each intervention; separate root gallery follows original prospective gameplay rule.
